_readme: Attribution facts for every external data source Terrium redistributes

WHY A DATA FILE AND NOT A CONSTANT IN EACH LANGUAGE
The exported Antimony model and SBML are built in Python; the trajectory
CSV is built in TypeScript. All three carry BRENDA-derived values and all
three owe the same attribution. Writing the licence twice would be two
statements of one fact that drift -- ADR 0003 (two copies of a numeric
bound), ADR 0027 (a reliability score implemented twice and computing
different things). A licence is a worse thing to be wrong about than
either, because the failure is silent and the party harmed is not the
Not generated, and not committed build output: this file is the source.
Both languages read it; neither owns it.
NOTICE remains authoritative prose. Every field here is transcribed from
it, and scripts/check_data_source_attribution.py fails when the two
disagree -- so a licence change is made in NOTICE first.
Field names map onto CC BY 4.0 3(a)(1) one-for-one so a reader can check
the rendered block against the legal code rather than against taste.

sources.modifications: rows filtered by organism and substrate; units normalised; values lacking assay pH/temperature flagged as incomplete. Measurements themselves are never altered.
